notes: Standard VAT 23% since 1 Jan 2025 (PwC; Financna sprava). Investment gold is VAT-exempt under s.67 of the Slovak VAT Act (Financna sprava); silver is not covered by the scheme, so bars and jewellery take 23%. Slovak jewellery is typically 585 (14k). No Slovak dealer published price list could be opened and read, so premiums, buyback, used-gold and making figures are null.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Slovak Republic, Corporate Other taxes
sources.what: From 1 January 2025 a basic VAT rate of 23% (previously 20%) applies to all taxable supplies, with reduced rates of 19% and 5% for listed categories only.

sources.name: Financna sprava (Slovak Financial Administration) - VAT deduction guidance
sources.what: Tax authority guidance applying the 23% standard rate and referring to supplies of investment gold exempt from VAT under s.67(3) of the Slovak VAT Act.
